display_protocol.rgb_annotation: GT target RGB, not predicted RGB
display_protocol.alignment: Source per-target LiDAR alignment; not the main-table anchor-scale protocol.
display_protocol.depth_alignment: Positive scalar minimizing AbsRel for Ours, VGGT-World and Compressed VGGT; affine inverse-depth least squares for DINO-Foresight.
display_protocol.registration: Ours: predicted query pose. Baselines: target GT FRONT pose for display only.
display_protocol.sky_filter: Same GT RGB SegFormer sky mask for all methods: sky argmax and confidence >= 0.5; no dilation.
display_protocol.geometry: Exact subset of original XYZ/RGB records. No smoothing, recolouring, or replacement by GT depth.
display_protocol.vggt_world_checkpoints: Paper A uses the official Cityscapes checkpoint recorded by the source gallery; 041, 048 and 021 use the Waymo-trained checkpoint_23.pt.
